**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Keyed `For` row renders non-deterministically: `{call}` runs while rendering the row; a lazy row renders again in the browser, so read it outside the row (loader data, a prop, a signal) or in a handler / clientEffect (the For's rows stay recorded)
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Compute the value outside the row (in the component body, loader data or a prop) and read that inside the row, or move the read into a handler / `clientEffect`; `Date.now()`, `Date()`, `new Date()` without arguments, `Math.random()`, `performance.now()`, `crypto.randomUUID()` and `crypto.getRandomValues()` are reported on a keyed `For` row's render path.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { For } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export function Feed(props: { items: { id: string; title: string }[] }) {
  return (
    <ul>
      <For each={props.items} by={(item) => item.id}>
        {(item) => <li data-seen={Date.now()}>{item().title}</li>}
      </For>
    </ul>
  );
}
```

```tsx prefer
import { For } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export function Feed(props: { items: { id: string; title: string }[]; seen: number }) {
  return (
    <ul>
      <For each={props.items} by={(item) => item.id}>
        {(item) => <li data-seen={props.seen}>{item().title}</li>}
      </For>
    </ul>
  );
}
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode (lazy collection rows, LAZY-ROWS T2). A warning: the module compiles and the `For` keeps today's per-row resume records. A lazy row (the `For`'s row function as a resumable symbol, materialised in the browser per row) must render the same markup in the browser as on the server; a time / random read in the row's render path would not. Handlers, effects, client events, refs and timer callbacks inside the row are not its render and are not checked. Reported once per `For`, on the server compile.
